libwebsockets_4.0.21_msvc143_x64_websock.build_flags: /MD /O2 /Ob2 /Zi (CMake Release, /Zi added), /WX- through _CL_; /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEBUG /Brepro /OPT:NOREF /OPT:NOICF at link; TLS via OpenSSL 1.1.1w as a separate DLL (not part of the artefact)
libwebsockets_4.0.21_msvc143_x64_websock.compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35229 for x64
libwebsockets_4.0.21_msvc143_x64_websock.notes: The same tag, feature switches and TLS backend as the MinGW recipe for this version; only the compiler differs. OpenSSL 1.1.1w is built from the pinned archive with MSVC (shared, no-asm) and linked through its import libraries, so it is imported, not linked in. The DLL is websockets.dll because MSVC has no library prefix. Built against the DLL runtime, so the MSVC C runtime is imported and stays attributed to data/MSVC. No-TLS, SChannel and mbedTLS builds are different code and are not covered.
